name: Korinek et al. 2026 faithful port: very rigid cognitive wage (xi = 0.9)
description: Sensitivity overlay from Table 6 (p.38): the cognitive wage closes only 10 percent of its gap to the clearing wage a year (xi = 0.9, a half-life of seven years). Applied to the base file it is the Substantial xi = 0.9 column of Table 6; its tests assert that column. The other Table 6 columns are checked in src/core/korinekFaithful.test.ts.
